svg.title: Amyloid-PET: Amyloid PET
svg.desc: Amyloid-PET (Amyloid PET), acquisition cost 5.0 units. Detects amyloid plaque build-up: information distinct from MRI and FDG-PET. Incremental AUC over the cheap-only model at 12, 24 and 36 months: +0.003, +0.035, +0.051.
svg.text: AUC gain over the cheap-only model

g.text: Its value rises from 12 to 36 months
